title: The Lord's Supper
introduction: The Lord's Supper was instituted by Jesus on the evening before he died. The bread and wine remind us of his body and blood, given for us. It is a communal meal that unites us with Christ and with one another, proclaiming his death until he comes.

sections.title: Institution
sections.description: Jesus instituted the Lord's Supper during the last meal with his disciples.

sections.title: Do this in remembrance of me
sections.description: Jesus commanded us to continue celebrating the Lord's Supper in remembrance of him.

sections.title: Fellowship with Christ
sections.description: The Lord's Supper is participation in the body and blood of Christ.

sections.title: Worthy Participation
sections.description: We are to examine ourselves before participating in the Lord's Supper.

sections.title: The New Covenant
sections.description: The cup represents the new covenant in Jesus' blood.
